C1381.title: U.S. DOJ Dismantles IoT Botnet Spanning 3 Million Devices
C1381.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice dismantled a botnet comprising 3 million IoT devices, which was used to launch record-breaking 31.4 Tbps DDoS attacks. Attackers hijacked a massive number of smart devices to form the botnet and conduct extortion-driven assaults.

references.title: DoJ Disrupts 3 Million-Device IoT Botnets Behind Record 31.4 Tbps DDoS Attack
